last.verdict: Cloudflare's growth sped up to 39%, its fastest in nearly four years, and it raised the 2026 outlook sharply, with margins slipping on the way.

takeaways.label: Growth keeps speeding up
takeaways.text: Revenue hit $782.5M, up 39% from a year ago, and annualized revenue passed $3B. Customers staying and spending more rose to 122%, from 120% last quarter.

takeaways.label: Outlook raised sharply
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue is now guided to $2.963–2.964B, up from $2.864–2.870B in August. Q4 guidance of $845–846M implies roughly 38% growth, a slight slowdown.

takeaways.label: Gross margin keeps falling
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin fell to 72.4% from 75.3% a year ago. Management blames the fast-growing developer platform, Workers, which earns less per dollar of sales.

takeaways.label: Profit up, cash flow lags
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating margin reached a record 17.5%, but free cash flow was 10% of revenue versus 13% a year ago, as spending on network equipment rose.

history.verdict: Accelerating growth and a raised full-year outlook won buyers, though much of the after-hours pop faded.

reasons.label: Growth sped up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 36% from a year earlier, up from 34% last quarter, beating expectations.

reasons.label: Margins and one-time costs
reasons.text: Gross margin fell to 73.1% from 76.3%; a $150.7M restructuring charge weighed on results.
